newsitem.title: USA: D.H. Marketing sees pre-tax Q3 $0.36/shr.
newsitem.headline: D.H. Marketing sees pre-tax Q3 $0.36/shr.

text.p: D.H. Marketing & Consulting Inc said Monday it expected to post pre-tax earnings of $0.36 a share in the third quarter and $0.40 a share in the fourth quarter.
The company today posted pre-tax earnings of $0.32 a share in the second quarter, which it accurately forecasted on May 22.
D.H. Marketing reported second-quarter net earnings of $0.19 a share, compared with $0.12 a share a year ago.
The company's stock traded at 14 Monday afternoon, up 1/16.
